note: Distribution operates continuously in two modes (section 4). No production BUILD without a credible first-customer path.

validation_distribution.objective: Reduce uncertainty and obtain stronger evidence.

scale_distribution.objective: Expand a proven channel with acceptable economics and delivery stability.

pre_build_refusal_rule: Before BUILD, production application engineering is prohibited. Implementation is permitted only when its explicit purpose is to reduce a documented uncertainty in validation.plan.json.
